thought.text: The frontend login page renders perfectly (full SvelteKit UI, "Qonnectra – Dokumentations-Plattform", login form). My `/api/v1/project/` guess was a wrong path. Let me query a real data endpoint from the API root:

reasoning_content:
The frontend login page is rendering correctly — the complete SvelteKit UI with the "Qonnectra" branding, login form, and "Dokumentations-Plattform" tagline. This proves the frontend, Caddy, and the authentication redirect chain are all working.

My guess for the `/api/v1/project/` endpoint was wrong (404 Page not found — that URL path doesn't exist), but this is just me guessing the wrong endpoint. Let me use a real endpoint from the API's root listing. Let me check the correct project endpoint from the API's root.

action.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo "=== real data endpoints from API root ==="
curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://api.localhost/api/v1/ | tr ',' '\n' | grep -oE '"[a-z_]*":"http://api.localhost/api/v1/[a-z_]*/"' | sed 's/"//g' | grep -vE "attributes|auth" | head
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -X POST https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin!LocalDev123"}' | tr -d '\n' | sed 's/.*"access":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
echo "=== project data (correct endpoint) ==="
curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/projects/" -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" | head -c 300
